subject: [PATCH v5 02/22] iomap: split iomap_iter() logic into iomap_iter_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch splits out the logic of iomap_iter() into a new helper function called iomap_iter_next(). This is done in preparation for changing iomap to use an in-iter model, where ->iomap_next() implementations can call iomap_iter_next() directly. The patch also introduces macros to generate boilerplate code for ->iomap_next() wrapper functions. No functional changes are intended, but there may be a behavioral difference on the error path of iomap_end().
